summary: Fields aligning in Badge builder

summary: Fields duplication in Badge builder

summary: Category field movable on Badge builder

summary: Fields Margin Left and Right in Badge builder
text: Added Left Margin and Right Margin settings to every field in the physical Badge builder, including QR codes. Badge field margins set in the builder show in the preview and apply wherever the badge is printed.

summary: QR code and Barcode resize in Badge builder
text: Added a percentage size setting (default 100%) for QR codes and barcodes in the physical Badge builder. Resized QR codes and barcodes show in the badge preview and print at that size everywhere.

summary: Parent-Child management on Frontend v.1
epic: Parent-Child. Parents adding/creating children on frontend

summary: OTP Android: allow entering password code by copypasting
Floorplan Admin Panel - add Exhibitor name & Stand label + Hide Stand mode

Floor plan stands show the exhibitor name above the stand number on web and app, and admins can hide individual stands or stand labels per hall.

summary: EMEA: Add the option to make custom text field as a website field

summary: Add Badges Variable in "Visitor Switch Category" Template
text: Added badge variables (print badge link, badge barcode, badge QR code, print badge QR code) to the 'Visitor Switch to Category' registration email template. Visitors who switch category can receive their badge print link and codes in that email.

summary: Update BitBucket runner version
EMEA: Add option for state/region and city field in the custom select field
text: Added State/Region and City as types for the custom Select form element in exhibitor and visitor registration settings. Organisers can build custom select fields that list states/regions or cities.

Remove unused objc files
Account Interactions public endpoint. Formatting changes + doc
New Floorplan - indication for hyperlinks (location)

summary: EMEA: Sponsored Session Should be Visible on Company Profile
text: Added a Sponsored Sessions block to the exhibitor profile in the webview, reusing the session card, slider and Show All behaviour. Exhibitor profiles automatically show a sponsored-sessions block when the exhibitor sponsors sessions, and hide it when they sponsor none.

summary: Verify stands and halls uniqueness during import from excel the halls and stand numbers
text: Added uniqueness checks for halls per event and stands per hall in Excel import, admin creation, and API v1 and v2. Duplicate hall or stand names are rejected on import, and admins see 'Halls can't have identical names' or a duplicate-stand error.

summary: Need Possibility to add the 'notes' present in exhibitor profile in BO in Excel export file
text: Added a 'Notes' column and export checkbox to the Exhibitors export, carrying the Notes field from the exhibitor profile in the admin panel. The Exhibitors export includes each exhibitor's notes when 'All fields' or the 'Notes' checkbox is selected.

summary: Need possibility to display 24 items on the catalogue page instead of 12 by default
text: Added a general setting for the default number of marketplace items per page (8 to 60, default 12). The marketplace opens with the per-page count set in admin; existing events keep 12.

summary: EMEA: Remove product category auto selection
text: Added a 'Bulk selection of sub-category items' setting, shown when parent categories are selectable, and applied it to profile category pop-ups. Organisers choose whether ticking a category also ticks its sub-categories; when off, only the clicked checkbox is checked on exhibitor and visitor profiles.

summary: (App+Web) EMEA: Remove the stand hall meeting option from selection after In-person event ends
text: Hid in-person meeting locations (Stand-Hall, Other, Exhibitor stand) on web and app once the allowed offline meeting time has passed. After the last offline slot, meeting requests offer only 'Online meeting', respecting event and user time zones.

summary: Allow selection of number of characters for the news description
text: Added an 'Article characters limit' setting per exhibitor category, replacing the hardcoded 1,000-character cap on exhibitor news. Organisers set the news character limit per category (0 for unlimited); existing over-limit articles stay but cannot be saved until trimmed.

summary: EMEA_ Add Session Id column for Favorited Session Report in Sessions
text: Added a Session ID column as the last column of the By session favourited sessions report and its export's All sessions tab. The By session report and its export show each session's ID, matching the Session ID in the sessions data export.

summary: Elasticsearch News index synchronization

summary: Add load indication for Marketing Content

summary: Allow displayment of Speakers with INACTIVE status on the frontend
text: Added a Show inactive speakers on the frontend toggle to registration settings, covering inactive, invited, uploaded and approved speaker statuses. When the toggle is on, speakers without an active account appear in frontend speaker lists; blocked, banned and waitlisted speakers stay hidden.

summary: Auto confirmation of meetings | Participant Category Level
text: Added a 'Meeting autoconfirm' toggle at participant-category level, extending the existing event-wide auto-confirmation setting. Meeting requests sent by participants in an enabled category confirm automatically and the Pending status is hidden once no pending meetings remain.

summary: Marketing content limit on individual level
text: Added marketing content permission and limit settings on the individual exhibitor, with 'last saved' precedence over category-level settings. Organisers set per-exhibitor content limits that category changes, imports and the API do not overwrite once changed locally.

summary: NA: Marketing content description to be extended to 3000 characters
text: Added a per-exhibitor-category 'File description characters limit' setting for marketing content and relaid the content screens with a More button. text: Added a 'Mobile app logins' custom report in Analytics/Export: an XLS with iOS and Android tabs listing each user login with profile fields. Organisers can export logins per app, with ID, timestamp, name, email, company, job title and category, and derive total and unique logged-in users.

summary: Changes and additions from IMEX part 1

summary: EMEA: Header of chat is fixed on the web version
text: Made web chat windows minimisable to a header tab, with unread-message badges and a maximum of three windows. Clicking a chat header collapses it to a 360×63 tab at the bottom of the page; collapsed tabs show unread counts and expand on click.

summary: Passwordless logination

User have to enter other location by himself when no other location mentioned in admin panel
text: Turned 'Other location' into a required free-text input when 'Allow other location' is on but no other locations are configured. Meeting requesters must type the other location, which is sent to and validated by the backend as otherLocation.

summary: Indication of Email errors in admin panel
text: Added 'Empty email' and 'MX issue' warnings alongside the existing fake-email warning in the participants list and meeting wizard. Organisers see a warning mark with the error name for participants with no email or a broken MX configuration.

summary: Redirection ExpoFP Floorplan
text: Added an External floorplan setting so marketplace stand links in app and web redirect to an ExpoFP floor plan via dynamic linking, a static URL, or no link. Organisers enable external floor plan linking in event setup; stand names deep-link to the matching ExpoFP stand, open a set URL in apps, or show unlinked.

summary: Redirection links ExpoFP Floorplan
text: Extended ExpoFP floorplan redirection for clickable stands from the marketplace to all other front-end places that show stands. Stand links on exhibitor, product, session, exhibitor event, schedule and recommendation pages redirect to the external floorplan.

summary: Optimize SEO with links (Add LinkWrapper)
Forbid exhibitors to add active products for those who are not allowed & let them arrive on Active products by default in the company profile.
text: Added settings to block product creation once an exhibitor's active-product limit is reached and to choose the default products tab. Organisers can disable '+ Add Product' at the limit, set All/Active/Inactive as the default tab; a disclaimer and toggle tooltips explain status.

summary: Filter and pagination retention after booking meetings
text: Added a meeting setting to return users to the page where they started a meeting request, keeping filters and pagination. Organisers choose between the meetings page and the initiating page; from marketplace and delegate lists users return with filters and page retained.

summary: Add Translation Cache Clearing Functionality to clearInstanceCached Methods
Add 5 filters for Sessions to the file import
text: Added the five session filters to the sessions XLS import and to the sessions export. Session filters in an import file are loaded into the admin panel; if the file has none, the filters stay empty.

summary: Exhibitor Manual sections need to have the possibility to being divided by their links
text: Made Exhibitor Manual section links open their specific section, while the main Online Exhibitor Services link opens the first unsubmitted page. Each section link opens its own section regardless of submissions or deadlines.

summary: Appointment redirection from Old UI
Multi-Language Email templates - Marketing
text: Added a language selector to Marketing Email Sender and Campaign template creation and editing, so templates can be set per language. Marketing emails go out in each recipient's pre-selected language, with the default language used for recipients who have none.

summary: Mobile redirection ExpoFP Floorplan
text: Extended ExpoFP floorplan stand linking (dynamic, external URL or off) to every clickable stand in the mobile apps. Stand links on app brand, exhibitor, product and session profiles, lists and recommendations follow the admin external floorplan setting.

summary: Exhibitor Events, new page for Mobile team ( My exhibitor events)
text: Created a mobile-only /mobile/exhibitorevents page, embedded as a webview in the iOS and Android apps, listing a participant's booked exhibitor events. Logged-in app users see their booked exhibitor events by date in a read-only list; only the date picker is interactive.

summary: Exhibitor Events. Public list in apps using widget. ( All exhibitor events)
text: Added a web-view page listing all exhibitor events in the apps, where users can only switch dates, filter and add to schedule. Logged-in participants browse exhibitor events in the iOS and Android apps and add them to their schedule.

summary: Visit G2 pull external leads to EP
epic: Visit G2 Implementation (External page for badge/scanner)
text: Added a 'Sync scanned leads' setting to the Visit integration that pulls leads scanned in Visit into the EP database. With the setting on, Visit-scanned leads merge with internal leads and appear in the interactions dashboard and leads downloads.

summary: Visit G2 external scanner
epic: Visit G2 Implementation (External page for badge/scanner)
text: Added a 'Use external leads scanner' Visit integration setting and stored each Visit account's embeddedVisitConnectURL for the mobile apps. When enabled and the URL exists, the apps open the vendor's scanner web app with an offline-capable stored session; otherwise the internal scanner shows.

summary: Visit G2 external badge
epic: Visit G2 Implementation (External page for badge/scanner)
text: Added a 'Use external badge' Visit integration setting and stored each Visit account's embeddedDigitalBadgeURL for frontend and mobile. When enabled and the URL exists, web and apps show the external badge (cached for offline use in apps); otherwise the internal badge shows.

summary: Changes and additions from IMEX part 3
text: Delivered a set of exhibitor event changes: Past status on ended cards, child and contact IDs in import, session-type hours, stand-hour checks and a review of post-approval edits. Organisers see exhibitor edits made after approval side by side (before and after) and can reject, edit or approve them; stand bookings outside available hours show a warning.

summary: Exhibitor events. Not editable after approval
text: Added a 'Not editable after approval' toggle to session types for exhibitor events. When on, exhibitors cannot edit or delete approved events on the front end (buttons hidden), while organisers can still change them.

summary: Text Editor
text: Restored the rich text editor for About the company in the new-UI exhibitor profile editor and verified all ten formatting options. Exhibitors can format About the company with headings, lists, alignment, quotes, photos and links, and saved text and images persist.

summary: ExpoPlatform's Check-In app: Ability to scan external QR and Barcodes and capture the unique code number in reports
text: Let the check-in app scan external QR codes, barcodes and co-located event badges, and added scanned code and event name columns to the Check-in list report. Unknown codes are saved and listed rather than rejected, and the check-in report shows each scanned code and, if recognised, its event.

summary: Need ability to scan QR & Barcodes in the App that are not related to Expoplatform data without breaking the App.
text: Added an 'Allow users to scan any codes' setting so the mobile app can scan and store QR/barcodes unrelated to platform accounts. With the setting on, unknown codes are saved as 'Code successfully scanned' and appear in a new 'Scanned code' column in lead and scan exports.

summary: Change Code to scan QR codes for colocated events
text: Allowed mobile app users to scan badges of accounts from co-located events in the same database, behind a new contact-sharing toggle. With the setting on, other-event scans are saved with an 'other event' ribbon, and scan reports and leads files gain an 'Event name' column.

summary: (APP) Meeting request includes the attached file option
text: Added an optional file attachment to the regular meeting request flow in the app, enabled by a new toggle in meeting settings. When enabled, requesters can attach a file to a meeting request, and recipients can open or download it from the meeting card in their schedule.

summary: EMEA: Lead capture page - company name & person name clickable to lead the person to company profile/personal profile
text: Made the person's name and, for team members, the company name clickable on the mobile lead capture screen after a badge scan. Tapping the name opens the person's public profile; tapping a team member's company opens their exhibitor's profile; non-team members' company stays plain text.

summary: Mobile App - Replace Matchmaking Information Wording
text: Renamed 'Matchmaking information' to 'Profile Information' on public profiles in the mobile app. App public profiles label the section 'Profile Information'.

summary: Mobile App - Add support for US English language
text: Added US English to the mobile apps, chosen by phone locale and initially a copy of UK English with 'Favorites' spelling. Users with a US English phone locale see US spelling in the app, such as 'Favorites' on My Profile.
